up: Show the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1741324. Include the ChEMBL identifier of the compound, the exact activity value, the standard units, and the standard type (e.g., IC50).
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741324' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
